assumptions: Every well shares the same backbone panel; the backbone explains the exploratory marker the same way in every well.
limits: Linear (any polynomial degree), SVM and XGBoost models; infinityFlow’s keras neural-network fitter is not ported.
bio.jane/contract.question: What would every Infinity marker of the screen read on each cell, from the backbone alone?

description: Infinity Flow backbone imputation for a massively parallel cytometry screen (LEGENDScreen-style): the project's FCS wells share a backbone panel and each carries one exploratory antibody; per well a regression of the exploratory channel on the logicle-transformed, per-well-scaled backbone is fitted on a random half, and every well's model imputes its marker on held-out events of every well, with isotype background correction.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

backbone.description: comma-separated backbone channels ($PnN); empty for all but time and the exploratory.

degree.description: polynomial degree of the linear model.

isotype_column.description: sheet column with each well’s isotype; empty for no background correction.

sample_sheet.description: the project sample sheet naming each well’s target and isotype.

samples.description: comma-separated FCS wells; empty for every project FCS file.

target_column.description: sheet column with each well’s Infinity target.

xgboost.description: also fit XGBoost, infinityFlow’s default model.

name: impute_flow_cytometry_infinity

imputed.description: per model: the imputed events’ well and, per target, imputed and background-corrected values

wells.description: per well: target, isotype, events, training events, imputed events
